info.title: LAS SSO HTTP API
info.description: Implementation reference for the packaged server, not the aspirational design contract. Browser account/admin APIs use the SSO cookie, CSRF and same-origin writes; client credentials do not authorize those APIs. OAuth/OIDC paths retain protocol responses. Discovery is authoritative for protocol URLs. This file is offline documentation; no Swagger or /v3/api-docs route is installed. See the bilingual API reference for filter errors, browser pages, maintenance, retention and deployment boundaries.

host.description: Replace with the trusted canonical issuer host and external port; this default is only the local fixture.

get.summary: Obtain the CSRF token and its header/parameter names
get.description: Establishes CSRF state, not authentication. Preserve returned cookies and use the returned token/name on browser writes. Token may be masked; do not cache/log it.

201.description: ALTCHA v2 proof-of-work challenge, bound to purpose and source network

post.description: Does not log in. First result contains one-time recovery codes. Same key/body replay returns 200 with an empty code list, secretsAvailable=false and idempotentReplay=true. The Location header names /api/v1/users/{id}, but no GET route is implemented there.

Consumes a recovery credential and sets the Secure/HttpOnly/Strict __Host-las_recovery cookie for ten minutes. No token in the JSON response. CAPTCHA required only when risk policy demands it; no automatic login.

Set-Cookie.description: Restricted recovery cookie; never log its value

put.description: Requires the one-time recovery session and CSRF/same-origin. Clears recovery cookie; old password, login sessions and authorizations are invalidated. Login again normally.

patch.description: Trims displayName to 1-64 Unicode code points. avatarResourceId may be null to clear it or default-alien-01; not an arbitrary upload URL.

post.description: Checks current password directly, reserves case-sensitive current/historical names and enforces the 90-day change cooldown. Subject UUID is unchanged. A cooldown error includes availableAt.

Normal login sends currentPassword; required-change login sends temporaryPassword. Success ends the current session and invalidates old credentials/sessions/authorizations. Endpoint-local errors are application/json {code}, not Problem Detail.

400.description: Password policy/change code or validation Problem

post.description: Rechecks the password, changes HTTP session ID and sets session-bound fifteen-minute password evidence. Does not update old OIDC authorizations' auth_time or execute a pending operation.
Requires recent password evidence. Revokes the previous batch; returns ten one-time codes. No Idempotency-Key contract on this endpoint.

delete.description: Other sid: ends that SSO session and linked authorizations. Current sid: current implementation calls logoutAll, affecting all this user's SSO sessions/authorizations; not merely this browser.

404.description: No matching active session; empty body

204.description: All user sessions/authorizations ended; current HTTP session invalidated

400.description: Missing/blank/oversized key may return empty 400; other validation failures use Problem

200.description: Authorizations grouped by client, with display labels rather than timestamps

delete.description: Deletes this user's consent and ALL authorizations for the client, across sessions. Does not give a client-secret-authenticated worker this user API privilege.

200.description: Deletion status, including NONE when no pending request

post.description: Checks password directly. Thirty-day pending period; SSO administrator cannot self-delete. A pending/held account becomes restricted to deletion-status/cancel and logout.

delete.description: Checks password and key; cancels PENDING/HELD. DELETE carries a JSON body; preserve it through proxies.

get.description: Requires SSO_ADMIN browser login. status accepts ACTIVE/FROZEN/DELETED or absent for all; query matches username/display name or UUID. limit is clamped to 1-200. Cursor is a returned user UUID.

200.description: Details, including retained deleted identity; absent credential state/timestamps are null

post.description: Admin write guard: current database-backed admin session, recent password, CSRF, origin; reason and idempotency key. Self/admin/deleted targets are restricted. Revokes relevant sessions/authorizations and advances eligibility version.
Admin write guard; does not resurrect revoked tokens or sessions.
Admin write guard; target-wide logout, not a family-specific worker API.

Admin write guard. One-time credential expires in 30 minutes; replay returns credential=null/secretsAvailable=false/idempotentReplay=true. Human identity verification is an operator process, not established by this API.

get.description: status default ACTIVE; accepts ACTIVE/DISABLED/ALL. Query matches client ID/name. Opaque returned cursor, not a signed capability.

post.description: Admin write guard. Generates one 256-bit client secret shown once. No idempotency guarantee for create. Scopes must contain openid and only openid/profile; URI/audience lists max ten. Production URIs require reviewed HTTPS; insecure loopback is development-only.

patch.description: Admin write guard. This PATCH expects a full editable settings body, not JSON Patch or optional-field merge. Security-relevant changes can revoke authorizations; version/revocation results are returned.

post.description: Admin write guard; revokes client's authorizations across users.
Admin write guard; does not resurrect old grants/secrets.
Admin write guard. Replaces the single active secret and revokes existing authorizations. Replay returns no secret; lost first result requires deliberate new rotation with a new key.

get.description: status accepts PENDING/HELD/CANCELLED/EXECUTED, absent selects all.

post.description: Admin write guard; holdUntil must be in the future and no more than 90 days ahead. Internal reason and user-visible summary are separate. No Idempotency-Key contract.
Admin write guard; release HELD to PENDING. No Idempotency-Key contract.

get.description: Active FIRST_PARTY client-secret Basic only, not user Bearer/cookie. Seven-field decision; no business roles. stateVersion compares only inside the same issuer/subject/stateEpoch. Unknown UUID returns DENIED/PRINCIPAL_NOT_FOUND/version0/changedAt null; missing epoch or storage returns 503, not denial.

401.description: Empty body; WWW-Authenticate: Basic realm=LAS SSO internal

200.description: OIDC metadata; use issuer and advertised endpoint/authentication/algorithm values
Framework OAuth authorization-server metadata; trusted issuer and actual endpoints

post.description: Framework RFC7662 endpoint. Registered client authentication required; default provider is not an owner-only family API. A client able to present a token can receive stored active-token metadata. Unknown/inactive token returns active=false. This checks stored token state, not service-access eligibility or fixed family refresh deadline; does not recover B or prove family cleanup from old A. No broader resource-server policy is promised.

Framework authorization/consent form endpoint. Initial form carries the same code-flow parameters as GET; consent uses the framework's saved transaction/client/state and approved scopes, not arbitrary return destinations. Application continuation/reauthentication and expired-session handling have stronger evidence for GET; do not claim all form combinations are independently verified.

get.description: Browser navigation. Pre-registered confidential client, exact redirect, openid, code and PKCE S256. OIDC prompt/max_age checked. May return login/reauthentication/consent UI; do not treat a redirect as authentication success.

post.description: Authorization code exchange or refresh only for registered grants. Rotates RT; serialize same-session refresh. Result uncertainty is not permission to reuse A. Family has a fixed fourteen-day refresh deadline; refreshing never advances auth_time.

RFC7009 current-token revocation. Unknown/invalid Token also returns 200. A consumed predecessor RT is not resolved through RT history here: 200 for old A does not prove successor B/family cleanup. No automatic replay of A at the token endpoint. Residual JWT access and remote recovery limits require consumer risk assessment, not a protocol success assertion.

200.description: Submitted token invalid/revoked; empty body, no family-level receipt

503.description: Unavailable; assume token may still exist and retry later

200.description: Claims allowed by scopes; sub must match ID Token

401.description: Missing/invalid/revoked Bearer; WWW-Authenticate, not browser login

post.description: Framework form RP-Initiated Logout and confirmation handling; application response handler performs user-wide SSO logout after protocol validation. Not machine compensation. GET/POST form sequences must retain the framework's stored context; full POST parity is not independently claimed.

get.description: RP-Initiated browser logout. This application performs user-wide SSO logout after protocol validation. Original ID-token hints are retained across refresh while authorization exists. Not a background family-specific cleanup API.

200.description: HTML login form with CSRF state

post.description: Same-origin browser form, not OAuth password grant. Fields username/password/rememberDevice and returned CSRF parameter (normally _csrf); captchaPayload only when risk policy requires. Server stores validated OIDC continuation; no client-supplied loginTransaction/returnUrl contract.

302.description: Success continuation/required password change, or failure /login?error or /login?captcha; inspect destination, not status alone

429.description: Rate limited with Retry-After; text response

post.description: SSO form logout, CSRF protected; custom handler logs out all user SSO sessions/authorizations. A consuming site's current-application logout is a different endpoint owned by that BFF.

200.description: HTML password page for five-minute server-bound OIDC request

post.description: Application password page, not CSRF-exempt standard protocol endpoint. Requires stored challenge/current browser and same-origin; does not accept arbitrary return target or asserted subject.

401.description: Wrong password: HTML form; invalid/expired challenge: Problem Detail

get.description: Management listener; not exposed by the supplied public proxy. Does not include database readiness.
Includes database; connection timeout may precede 503. Internal management listener, not public proxy.

Opt-in monitoring profile, dedicated private management port/collector credentials; not OIDC client credentials or admin cookie. Default package Compose enables monitoring; other deployments must configure it.

ssoSession.name: __Host-las_sso
ssoSession.description: SSO browser cookie; Secure HttpOnly Lax, Path=/, no Domain. Admin operations additionally require SSO_ADMIN; writes require CSRF/origin and applicable recent-password evidence.

recoverySession.name: __Host-las_recovery
recoverySession.description: Restricted one-time password-recovery cookie; Secure HttpOnly Strict, ten minutes.

oidcClientBasic.description: Registered confidential OIDC client_id/client_secret; standard client_secret_basic encoding.

firstPartyBasic.description: Dedicated active FIRST_PARTY registration; only for internal eligibility query, not a human principal.

accessToken.description: SSO Access Token with openid scope and active authorization; not ID Token.

collectorBasic.description: Independent las-sso-metrics collector; management listener only.

Csrf.name: X-CSRF-TOKEN
Csrf.description: Use headerName/token returned by /api/v1/csrf with the same cookies, or its returned form parameter. Documented header is the current default.

Origin.name: Origin
Origin.description: Same canonical issuer origin; when absent Referer of the same origin is required. At least one is needed for application browser writes.

IdempotencyKey.name: Idempotency-Key
IdempotencyKey.description: Nonblank key up to 128 characters; UUID recommended. Actor+operation scope, 24 hours; same key with different material returns conflict. Auth/CSRF checks still apply on replay.

Status.name: status
Status.description: Endpoint-specific accepted status values; see operation description.

Cursor.name: cursor
Cursor.description: Pass the returned cursor unchanged with the same filters. Not a signed/authorized capability.

Problem.description: Application error; stable code, safe detail, requestId; no-store. Some framework binding/filter errors may instead have the shapes described in the API reference.

BrowserUnauthenticated.description: Expired session/filter or endpoint-local error may be {code} JSON; anonymous browser request may redirect to login. No universal Problem envelope.

BrowserForbidden.description: CSRF/role/origin/recent-password/required-change/deletion restriction. Filters may emit {code} JSON or framework response; MVC errors use Problem Detail.

RateLimited.description: Retry only after indicated delay; protocol client authentication may retain OAuth error format

OAuthError.description: Standard OAuth error, never wrapped as application Problem

parameters.description: ALTCHA PoW v2 ChallengeParameters, pass unchanged to the widget

Password.description: 12-128 Unicode code points, at most 512 UTF-8 bytes; not equal to username or bundled common-password list; no trimming of passwords

clientId.description: Omit/blank to generate; otherwise 3-100 letters/digits/dot/underscore/hyphen, starting alphanumeric

token_type_hint.description: Hint only; unknown hint must not redefine token ownership.
